turns:
Summarize this in two sentences:

Last spring the city of Harwick started a six-month pilot that lent electric bikes to 400 office workers for their daily commute. Each rider paid 15 dollars a month, and the city covered the rest of the cost with a 90,000-dollar grant from a regional transport fund. According to the final report published in November, car trips among the participants fell by 38 percent, and the average commute became four minutes shorter because riders could use the new bus lanes. Most complaints were about the lack of secure parking near offices and about batteries running low on cold mornings. The council voted eight to three to continue the scheme next year with 1,000 bikes, and to build 12 covered bike shelters in the business district before the summer.
truth: Two sentences: Harwick's 6-month e-bike pilot (400 commuters, $15/month, $90k grant) cut their car trips 38% and commutes by 4 min; despite complaints about parking and cold-weather batteries, the council (8-3) expanded it to 1,000 bikes with 12 covered shelters.
